sources.section: QNCCARD.JSON (format, version, clips: id, name, original, proxy, poster, record) and QNCCARD/<clip>.json (QNC clip metadata).

sources.title: QNC card base (the quasi card of the tray's ingest)
sources.section: A base folder made by QNC-AI's tray: QNCCARD.JSON at its root lists the clips (original, proxy, poster, record); QNCCARD/<clip>.json is each clip's finished record; original/ and products/ hold the copied media and posters.

pattern.applicability: A base the tray's ingest of QNC-AI made from a card: the standardized quasi card QNC reads as any card (user 2026-11-15).
pattern.naming_rule: QNCCARD.JSON lists every clip with paths relative to the base folder; the index overrides any name.
pattern.status_reason: Written by QNC itself to its own standard (format qnc-base-card 1).
pattern.grouping_notes: QNCCARD.JSON gives each clip's id (its recording identity), original, proxy, poster and record.
pattern.limitations: A base is read only; a project never writes it. Media paths come only from the index.

metadata.meaning: Original relative to the base folder; never an OS absolute path.
The clip's finished record (QNC clip metadata).

evidence.supports: The format of the index and the records.
Index, record and media layout of a base.
